summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical implementation of Face ID data. It was confirmed that the system needs to display both a Face ID and an [unknown] ID associated with a given Frame ID. Previously, fake face data was generated by the team when adding frames. The user successfully retrieved and shared an example JSON structure containing arrays of faces, each mapped to an 'id' and a 'user_id'.
decisions: The system must display Face ID and [unknown] ID per Frame ID.
